reasons.clean_system_data: Low system/user impact with no protected or user-value content detected; positive high-confidence evidence available.
reasons.confidence_gate_promoted: Promoted to review: high confidence is required to recommend deletion; confidence was {confidence}.
reasons.confidence_low: Classification confidence is low; verification is required.
reasons.disposable_positive_evidence: Known disposable content with positive, high-confidence evidence of disposable purpose.
reasons.do_not_delete: Deletion of this item is not authorized.
reasons.downloads_policy: Known user Downloads location: folder-level deletion requires review (per-file assessments may vary; item authority I10 applies).
reasons.keep: No reliable disposability evidence; item is not disposable.
reasons.known_non_disposable: Understood and classified, but not positively disposable.
reasons.not_resolvable: Cannot be safely resolved in the current runtime; treated as unknown and never deleted without review.
reasons.protected_critical: Protected or system-critical path; deletion is not authorized.
reasons.r1_protected_critical: Protected/system-critical descendant bytes present: deletion not authorized.
reasons.r2_user_value: User-value descendant bytes present: manual review required.
reasons.r3_unknown: UNKNOWN descendant bytes present ({unknown_share:.1%}): any UNKNOWN blocks safe deletion (UNKNOWN_BLOCK = 0.0).
reasons.r4_known_non_disposable_share: Understood-but-not-disposable share ({known_share:.1%}) exceeds REVIEW_SHARE ({review_share:.0%}); manual review required.
reasons.r5_safe_to_delete: Disposable share ({disposable_share:.1%}) meets SAFE_MIN_SHARE ({safe_min_share:.0%}), known-non-disposable within ceiling ({known_non_disposable_ceiling:.0%}), positive direct disposable evidence, high confidence.
reasons.r6_review_first: Composition does not meet the safe-deletion criteria; manual review required.
reasons.review_before_delete: High-impact or protected content requires manual review before deletion.
reasons.uncertain: Impact could not be resolved with high confidence; safe deletion cannot be justified, so this item is kept for review.
reasons.unknown_impact: No reliable information about this item's impact was available during classification.
reasons.user_value: Personal/user-value content, or content the user may reasonably want; user consent is required before deletion.
